title: OpenAI halves the ChatGPT Pro 200 usage allowance and adds Pro 500
question: How will ChatGPT Pro subscribers react to this over the first two weeks, which groups will push back and why, and is OpenAI likely to keep, change or reverse the decision?

objections.text: Same $200 price for about half the usage is a hidden price rise
Existing paying subscribers are being cut, and limits already ran out too fast
Codex coding usage is halved and the top model did not get cheaper
OpenAI's explanations were unconvincing; some users cancelled or threatened to switch to Claude

backdown.summary: Cancelled the Pro 200 reduction the day before it took effect and said it doubled usage limits on all Pro tiers and Business Premium

pushback_groups: AI power users on X and forums
notes: The reversal came about a month after the announcement, outside the two-week window but before the cut took effect. A prediction of 'keeps it at first, then softens or reverses before the effective date' fits best. The Pro 500 tier stayed.
